photos: File:Bergs slussar och Carl Johans slusstrappa.JPG
note: Oscars sluss is a double lock in the Berg lock flight on the Göta Canal, north of Linköping.
Oscarsborg is a brick lookout tower from 1895 on Östra berget in Söderhamn.

photos: File:Oscarsstenen monument with sun and lens flare.jpg
note: Oscarsstenen is a limestone memorial on Visborgsslätt in Visby, raised for the colours King Oscar I presented in 1854.
Oscarsvärn is the landward fortification by Sunna kanal in Karlskrona, built out in the 19th century to guard the road into the naval town.
Oskar-Fredriksborg is a fortress built in 1870–1877 on eastern Rindö, opposite Fredriksborg across Oxdjupet.
Oskarsvärn on Hästö is the eastern part of Karlskrona’s land front, with a large sealed bunker and smaller shelters.
Ottenby gravfält is a large Iron Age and Viking Age burial ground on the southern tip of Öland.
Överby kvarn in Sollentuna is a mid-19th-century smock mill, the only working windmill in Stockholm County.
Oxebo vattensåg is a preserved water-powered sawmill with a grill spot and a small bathing place by the lake.
Parsetjärns skans is a Second World War fortification west of Ed, built to block a German advance from Norway.
Penåsa ödeby is a deserted 18th-century farmstead on the Great Alvar of Öland, with house foundations and garden plants.
Per Gynts grotta at Norr Amsberg is a small cave tied to the legend of the highwayman Per Gynt.
Pershyttan is a medieval mining village outside Nora, protected since 2004 as the cultural reserve Gamla Pershyttans bergsmansby.
Pjäsvärn nr 740 is a numbered gun emplacement on the west coast of Skåne.
This is open ground where the last fighting of the Battle of Lund in 1676 is said to have taken place, with no memorial stones on the field itself.
Porla brunn is a former spa between Laxå and Hasselfors, known for iron- and carbon-dioxide-rich mineral water.
Prekebogumman is the overgrown homestead at Prekebo near Öxabäck where the healer Kristina Andersson received patients.
Prinsessan Sofia Albertinas sluss is the upper lock at Lustigkulla in Hallstahammar on the Strömsholm Canal.
Prästakällan is an overgrown spring on the old 17th-century priest’s road between Glimåkra and Örkened.

other_sources.title: Beslut om beträdnadsförbud för Pyramiderna i Vålådalen

note: Pyramiderna are glacial gravel formations in the Gröndalen ice-lake delta inside Vålådalen nature reserve.
Radiumkällan in Tyringe is a natural spring, earlier called Paradiskällan, renamed when the water was thought to be radioactive.

photos: File:Karta över kyrkogård vid Tornehamn från 1901.jpg
note: Rallarkyrkogården, also called Tornehamns kyrkogård, is the burial ground for workers who died building the Iron Ore Line.
Ramnäs övre sluss is a hand-worked lock on the Strömsholm Canal where it follows Kolbäcksån.
Rantens kvarn is a three-storey meeting hall in a former mill building.
The Raoul Wallenberg memorial in Helsingborg is the bronze briefcase sculpture Attachéväska R.W. in Ångfärjeparken.
Rasmus kvarn in Röttle is a preserved 17th-century water mill beside the falls of Röttleån.
The ropewalk in Åhus is a museum of the last rope-making works in Sweden, given to S:ta Annas Gille and moved here in 1971–1972.
Rindö redutt is a fort built in 1858–1863 on the western point of Rindö to cover the northern approach to Stockholm.
Rosenträdgården is a 1930s garden on the Helsingborg escarpment, with a view over the town and the Sound.
Rotensugnet is a nature reserve where Rotälven drops through a fault, with a timber flume and old pine forest.
RRGC Bocken was a Stril 60 radar-control centre inside Hallabjär at Degeberga, now sealed, with a memorial at the former entrance.
Rumpsaxgrottan is a small cleft in the rock rather than a deep cave, in the Södermanland archipelago.
The runestones at Stora Ramsjö, U 1174 and U 1175, stand by a burial ground east of Morgongåva.
The stone called Nf 56 is U Fv1958;250 at Sankt Lars ruin in Sigtuna, raised by Anund for himself while he was still alive.
At Balsta outside Eskilstuna stand three Viking Age runestones, Sö 107, Sö 108 and Sö 109, moved here from nearby roads.
U 390 is a granite runestone in Sigtuna, raised by Sven and Frödis in memory of Ulv, beside the ruin of Sankt Lars.
U 394 is a runestone recorded at Sankt Per’s church ruin in Sigtuna.
The Högby runestones stand on the old churchyard north of Högby, dominated by Ög 81, carved by Torkel in the early 11th century.

photos: File:Runestone 489 Gullög in memory of her daughter Gillög 11 cen AC, Uppsala, Sweden.jpg
note: U 489, the Lagga stone, now stands in the university park in Uppsala among several other runestones.
A small Viking Age runestone stands between busy roads, reached by a pedestrian and cycle crossing.
Brötastenen, Sö 292, is a tall runestone near Bröta in Grödinge on Södertörn.
Rutehall is a large split granite boulder with a natural grid pattern in the forest north of Traryd.
Ruveröds kvarn is a preserved 1830s mill on Ybbarpsån, north of Söderåsen National Park.
Ryds kvarn at Ryfors is an old toll mill on the upper Tidan, with waterwheels in a preserved ironworks landscape.
Ryds sågverksruin is the remains of a steam sawmill on the shore of Bolmen, worked from 1896 to 1907.
Rödbergsfortet is one of the five heavy forts of Boden Fortress and the one open for guided visits inside.

other_sources.title: Hembygdsgården med Röna koppargruva, Digitalt Museum

note: Röna gruva is a copper mine worked by English miners in the 1820s at Kläggstranden in Östmark, beside a mill and old houses.
Sankt Erik’s cave is a shallow ice-worn hollow in the rock on Marstrand, next to the cleft called Fru Arfvidsson’s bedchamber.

File:Drottens ruin och Sankt Lars ruin - KMB - 16001000042484.jpg
note: Sankt Lars ruin is a medieval church ruin in Visby, with passages inside the walls.
